correctness.rationale: With symmetric unstandardized W, exact summation of squared differences gives C=(n-1)/S0*(sum_i d_i z_i^2)/(sum_i z_i^2) -(n-1)/n I. For r-regular graphs the first quotient equals r and S0=nr, so C=(n-1)(1-I)/n for arbitrary nonconstant real data. For binary fields with k ones, q crossing edges, s total degree of ones and m=|E|, direct counting yields C=n(n-1)q/[2mk(n-k)] and I=[2k^2m+n(n-2k)s-n^2q]/[2km(n-k)]. Independent exact-fraction computation enumerated and canonically quotiented all connected graphs of n=2..5 with class counts 1,2,6,21 and checked every binary field; reversal-admitting graph classes 0,0,0,11. For P5 endpoint singleton A, (I,C)=(-1/16,5/8) and internal adjacent pair B=(1/24,5/6); a larger I but also larger C is strict ranking conflict. Substitution k,q,s into P_n verifies I(A)=-1/(n-1)^2, C(A)=n/[2(n-1)], I(B)=(n^2-4n-4)/[2(n-1)(n-2)], C(B)=n/[2(n-2)], with positivity for every n>=5 by elementary polynomial inequality; finite enumeration alone is not the unrestricted proof.
